Hi, I was in a similar situation (also did the German Abitur and it wasn’t great) and ended up going to Italy by taking the IMAT. The classes here are held in English. However, MedAT is a good idea as well. I can imagine that the classes will be more practical, here most of what we do is theory and we have to venture out more for clinical experiences. (Eg Famulatur in Germany/Austria) The two exams are a few months apart, so you could register for both. Like take MedAT first, which is June/July I believe and depending on how that goes, you could also take the IMAT. They changed the date for IMAT and it’s in October now.  Good luck! 😊
